answer: Re-attestations are stored in nebula and comet lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the jetty graph. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 19 epochs, which means holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 2436 identities would post 652 proofs and burn roughly 5 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
